name: Gomboc Ai Community
description: A Claude Code plugin for scanning, fixing, and creating ORL (Open Remediation Language) rules across Infrastructure as Code, containers, orchestration, and application code. Supports Terraform, HCL/Terragrunt, CloudFormation (YAML + JSON), Bicep, Dockerfile, Kubernetes, and Python.
longDescription:
Ships **24 skills** and **6 commands**.

- **Skills** (24): `gomboc_community_cap_orl_remediate` (Use when running `orl remediate` (dry-run or apply) against a workspace via Docker, writing a report and submitting…), `gomboc_community_cap_orl_rules_pull` (Use when pulling rules from the Gomboc Rules Service with `orl rules pull` (--search and/or --channel)), `gomboc_community_cap_orl_rules_push` (Use when pushing a local rule package with `orl rules push` via Docker), `gomboc_community_cap_orl_walk` (Use when exploring AST structure with `orl walk` for a language and path via Docker), `gomboc_community_cap_run_orl_test` (Use when running `orl test .` against a rule package via Docker), `gomboc_community_flow_apply_fix` (Use when applying a fix with an existing ORL rule or by generating a new one), `gomboc_community_flow_build_rule` (Use when building an ORL rule package — workspace, AST explore, write rule/tests, test loop), `gomboc_community_flow_convert_sentinel` (Use when converting a HashiCorp Sentinel policy into one or more ORL rules), and 16 more
- **Commands** (6): `add-metadata` (Add community metadata (name, description, classifications, annotations) to an ORL rule package), `convert-sentinel` (Convert a HashiCorp Sentinel policy (from a URL or file path) into one or more ORL rules), `create-rule` (Create an ORL rule end-to-end — plan, build, review, enrich, and optionally push to the Gomboc Rules Service), `diagnose` (Scan source code for security anti-patterns and compliance gaps; report findings and existing-rule coverage), `fix` (Scan source code for security anti-patterns and compliance gaps, then fix them — using existing ORL rules or…), `verify-mcp` (Verify the hosted Gomboc MCP server is configured and working — server ready plus a safe get_channels smoke…)

Installs with `claude plugin install gomboc-ai-community@claude-community` from `Gomboc-AI/gomboc-community-skills`.
